verdict.rationale: Docs describe a full no-code interactivity model built from states, events and actions, plus variables/real-time API and webhooks for conditional and data-driven behavior, and a code tab for custom JS-driven behavior layered over the 3D scene — together enabling prototypes that animate between states, react to conditions/variables, and respond to external triggers like scroll/webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming 'scroll' as a trigger/event type, and independent hands-on evidence validating these advanced behaviors work smoothly in practice (community evidence only covers basic 3D interaction, not advanced logic).
